lines.text: The Device tab is Cheeko's remote control.
lines.show: The Device tab is Cheeko's remote control.

lines.text: See the battery, the Wi-Fi network, and when Cheeko was last online.
lines.show: See the battery, the Wi-Fi network, and when Cheeko was last online.

lines.text: Too loud? Slide the volume down.
lines.show: Too loud? Slide the volume down.

lines.text: Set the brightness, and pick a colour theme for Cheeko's screen.
lines.show: Set the brightness, and pick a colour theme for Cheeko's screen.

lines.text: Turn system sounds and vibration on or off.
lines.show: Turn system sounds and vibration on or off.

lines.text: Sleep mode lets Cheeko nap by itself when nobody's playing.
lines.show: Sleep mode lets Cheeko nap by itself when nobody's playing.

lines.text: Then tap Save, and the changes go to Cheeko.
lines.show: Then tap Save, and the changes go to Cheeko.

lines.text: Got two Cheekos? Switch between them at the top.
lines.show: Got two Cheekos? Switch between them at the top.

lines.text: Remove Device unlinks a Cheeko. Your child's progress stays with them.
lines.show: Remove Device unlinks a Cheeko. Your child's progress stays with them.
